title: AED in Poland — OpenStreetMap Poland export
provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; export hosted by OpenStreetMap Polska
notes: Snapshot downloaded once and processed locally; end-user searches should use the imported registry.
Source record IDs are @osm_type/@osm_id, preserved independently of city partitions.
The export does not provide a verified census of all physical AED devices in Poland.
Per-object version and check_date are retained in raw tags; neither is substituted for our own verification date.
